events.text: Three riders of the strongest lord in this world come to your mine with a list of demands: a tenth of every year's stones, "for the protection of the road". The road never needed protecting before they rode up it.

ok.log: They draw. You do not let them finish drawing. They ride home with the list in pieces and a story that makes the next riders very polite.

fail.log: They are stronger than riders have any right to be. You wake in the ditch, and the list is pinned to the mine door with a knife.

choices.text: Pay them 300 taels and keep the stones

effects.log: Silver they understand. They take it and go, and come back next year, smiling. (300 taels)

choices.text: Offer them a fair contract to guard the road

effects.log: You turn the demand into a contract, and the contract into a road that really is guarded. The lord is puzzled, and keeps it.

choices.text: Let your guardians meet them at the gate

effects.log: You send word to the gate and stay where you are.
